project_type: Python FastAPI app - NEXUS Autonomous AI Company OS
test_framework: pytest with asyncio_mode=auto, tests/ directory at project root
verification_instructions: Run pytest and ensure all 2433+ tests pass. No new external dependencies allowed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. No new external dependencies. Do NOT touch dashboard/ directory. All code must have docstrings, type hints, pass ruff, 100 char line limit, Python 3.12.
contribution_requirements: Backward compatible changes only. Docstrings and type hints required. 100 char line length. ruff linting (select E, F, I, N, W, UP).
key_patterns: FastAPI with lifespan context manager in main.py. Governance modules in src/nexus/governance/. API routes in src/nexus/api/routes/. Models use SQLModel in src/nexus/models/. Config via pydantic-settings in src/nexus/config.py. Tests in tests/ directory with pytest-asyncio. Telemetry via in-process Counter/Histogram in src/nexus/telemetry.py. Logging via src/nexus/logging_config.py with JSON formatter.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ is the main package. Key sub-packages: api/ (routes, middleware, deps), governance/ (budget, audit, secrets, policies, circuit breakers), models/ (SQLModel tables), memory/ (layered memory store), runtime/ (heartbeat), evolution/ (analyzers), telemetry.py, config.py, main.py
